propositions: A new generator script must produce authoritative, registry-derived config and security reference documentation that stays in sync with the config schema and deprecation registries.

The generator must read three sources: rebar._config_schema (keys/types/defaults), rebar._deprecations.REGISTRY filtered to kind='cfg' (lifecycle), and rebar._child_env._ADAPTER_SECRET_NAMES (secret inventory), and emit two whole generated files with no partial-region markers.

Both generated docs must carry a top-of-file banner within the first 8 lines naming 'python scripts/gen_config_reference.py' to satisfy test_generated_surface_markers.py::test_text_surface_carries_a_banner.

The generator's --check mode must detect drift via newline-normalized comparison (handling CRLF checkouts without false failures) and be exercised by a pytest suite under make test without CI dependency.
docs/config.md must remain byte-unchanged and all its consumers (existing anchor links, content-asserting tests) must continue to pass, proven by a test that the generator never targets it.

The two generated docs must together cover all required topics (precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, MCP/CLI exposure) via explicit heading anchors, enforced by a topic-coverage test.
